weather.accumulation: April 15 sowing day inclusive through flight day inclusive

T: trapezoidal cover integral / actual elapsed history
last observed cover slope × total elapsed history
recursive_features.first_observation: AUC=cover; change=0; no earlier observation assumed
recursive_features.horizon: Each target flight defines one cutoff; source and target images must not exceed the same DAS/GDD cutoff; may have unequal counts; no future interpolation
recursive_features.support: Original 64 common-date plots retained, even before those common dates; retrospective support selection limitation

growth.selection: minimum AICc across bounded single logistic (signed rate, 3 parameters) and double logistic (5 parameters), two initializations each
growth.peak_domain: Observed DAS window only; boundary peaks are censored, not identified physiological peaks
growth.feature_availability: Whole season through 181 DAS; retrospective, not early forecasting
growth.failure_policy: Write optimization failures and boundary flags; no silent support exclusion or imputation

conformal.rank: ceil((n_cal+1)*0.9); augment calibration score distribution with +infinity
conformal.source_fits: Existing outer-block fits already exclude calibration block in fitting/tuning; residual audit reads those frozen predictions
conformal.center_fit: No extra center fit performed because +infinity radius is independent of center and of N0 offset
conformal.within_field: Not estimable under original nested block protocol after disjoint training/calibration/test blocks
conformal.domain_shift: No exchangeability guarantee across fields/years; one calibration block also precludes block-level finite 90% quantile

whole_block_intervals: 27 ordered bootstrap draws of three target blocks; fixed prediction fits; pointwise conditional intervals only
